## Description

Engagemen Analyzer [@Eguchi-2023] allows learners and teachers to find out rhetorical expressions in the user-input writing. This tool draws on the construct of Engagement in Appraisal Framework [@Martin-2005]. 

- For construction and evaluation of machine learning model, see @Eguchi-2023.

- For a tutorial article written for applied linguistics audience, see @Eguchi-2024.

![Example](media/illustration.png)
